feedback.summary: You take a clear not-ship stance supported by healthcare evidence and ethics codes in The Most Ethical Path. Your INTRODUCTION identifies stakeholders well. To improve, strengthen depth and accuracy across your DICUSSION: To Ship or Not to Ship, add visuals and abstract, and fix factual, maths and referencing errors.

Deepen your for/against evidence and add distinct decision guidance for your chip company, health department and end-user stakeholders.
